## Pakete laden

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(Biostrings)
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)     # vegdist
```

## Daten laden

```{r}
#| label: load-data

base_path <- "C:/Users/user/Documents/Master_EnvironmentalSciences/Master_Thesis"

# Phyloseq-Objekt
ps <- readRDS(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/Taxonomy_v2/phyloseq_all.rds"))

beetle_traits <- read.csv("~/Master_EnvironmentalSciences/Master_Thesis/Data/Metadata/beetle_traits.csv")

otu_mat_new <- readRDS(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/OTU_v2/otu_mat_new.rds"))

# ── Metadaten ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
meta_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  mutate(sample = gsub("^X", "", sample))

asv_map <- data.frame(
  asv_id   = paste0("ASV", seq_along(taxa_names(ps))),
  sequence = taxa_names(ps)
)

# ── Taxonomie aus phyloseq extrahieren ────────────────────────────────────────
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps))
tax_df$ASV         <- rownames(tax_df)
tax_df$Genus_clean   <- gsub("g__", "", tax_df$Genus)
tax_df$Species_clean <- gsub("s__", "", tax_df$Species)
```

## Clustering sinnvoll?

```{r}
# ASVs pro Lauf (nur wo Reads > 0)
for (run in c("EC24_245", "3XX", "Popa", "Buse")) {
  ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps, sequencing_run == run)
  ps_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)
  cat(run, ":", ntaxa(ps_sub), "ASVs\n")
}

# Überlapp zwischen Läufen
asvs_ec24 <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(ps, sequencing_run == "EC24_245")) > 0, ps))
asvs_3xx  <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(ps, sequencing_run == "3XX")) > 0, ps))
asvs_buse <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(ps, sequencing_run == "Buse")) > 0, ps))
asvs_popa <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(ps, sequencing_run == "Popa")) > 0, ps))

cat("\nÜberlapp EC24 & 3XX:", length(intersect(asvs_ec24, asvs_3xx)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp EC24 & Buse:", length(intersect(asvs_ec24, asvs_buse)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp 3XX & Buse:", length(intersect(asvs_3xx, asvs_buse)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp alle 4:", length(Reduce(intersect, list(asvs_ec24, asvs_3xx, asvs_buse, asvs_popa))), "\n")
```

Ja, Clustering ist sinnvoll.

## VSearch vorbereiten: ASV to OTU clustering for NMDS

```{r}

# Abundanz pro ASV berechnen
asv_counts <- colSums(seqtab_all)  # Gesamtreads pro ASV

# FASTA mit Abundanz als size= exportieren
seqs <- taxa_names(ps)
names(seqs) <- paste0("ASV", seq_along(seqs), ";size=", asv_counts[seqs])

writeXStringSet(
  DNAStringSet(seqs),
  file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output_v2/asvs_all_v2.fasta")
)

# Prüfen
readLines(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/DADA2_Output_v2/asvs_all_v2.fasta"), n = 10)

summary(asv_counts)
hist(log10(asv_counts + 1))
```

## Prüfen, ob Clustering erfolgreich war

```{r}
# ── Schritt 1: .uc Datei einlesen ─────────────────────────────────────────────
uc <- read.table(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/OTU_v2/otus.uc"),
                 sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Nur Hit-Zeilen (H) und Seed-Zeilen (S) behalten
uc_hits <- uc[uc$V1 %in% c("H", "S"), c("V1", "V9", "V10")]
colnames(uc_hits) <- c("type", "asv", "otu")

# Size-Tag entfernen
uc_hits$asv_clean <- gsub(";size=.*$", "", uc_hits$asv)
uc_hits$otu_clean <- gsub(";size=.*$", "", uc_hits$otu)

# Für S-Zeilen (Seeds) ist OTU = ASV
uc_hits$otu_clean[uc_hits$type == "S"] <- uc_hits$asv_clean[uc_hits$type == "S"]

cat("ASVs gemappt:", nrow(uc_hits), "\n")
cat("OTUs gesamt:", length(unique(uc_hits$otu_clean)), "\n")

# ── Schritt 2: OTU-Tabelle erstellen ──────────────────────────────────────────
# ASV-Matrix aus phyloseq (Samples × ASVs)
asv_mat <- as.matrix(t(otu_table(ps)))
colnames(asv_mat) <- gsub("^X", "", colnames(asv_mat))

# Mapping: Sequenz → OTU-Centroid
asv_to_otu <- setNames(uc_hits$otu_clean, uc_hits$asv_clean)

# ASV-Nummer → Sequenz Mapping
asv_map <- data.frame(
  asv_id = paste0("ASV", seq_along(taxa_names(ps))),
  sequence = taxa_names(ps)
)

# asv_mat Spaltennamen von Sequenz auf ASV-ID umstellen
colnames(asv_mat) <- asv_map$asv_id[match(colnames(asv_mat), asv_map$sequence)]

# Nur gematchte ASVs
shared <- intersect(colnames(asv_mat), names(asv_to_otu))
cat("Matches:", length(shared), "\n") #10833

# OTU-Tabelle durch Summierung
otu_mat_new <- t(rowsum(t(asv_mat[, shared]),
                         group = asv_to_otu[shared],
                         na.rm = TRUE))

cat("OTU-Tabelle:", nrow(otu_mat_new), "Samples ×", ncol(otu_mat_new), "OTUs\n")

# ── OTU-Tabelle speichern ──────────────────────────────────────────
saveRDS(otu_mat_new, file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/OTU_v2/otu_mat_new.rds"))
write.csv(otu_mat_new, file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/OTU_v2/otu_mat_new.csv"))

# Einlesen in zukünftigen Sessions:
# otu_mat_new <- readRDS(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/OTU_v2/otu_mat_new.rds"))


# ── Schritt 3: Distanzmatrix prüfen ───────────────────────────────────────────
dist_otu <- vegdist(otu_mat_new, method = "bray")
summary(as.vector(dist_otu))

# OTU-Overlap zwischen Läufen
meta_df_clean <- data.frame(sample_data(ps)) %>% rownames_to_column("sample")

for (run in c("EC24_245", "3XX", "Popa", "Buse")) {
  samples <- meta_df_clean$sample[meta_df_clean$sequencing_run == run]
  samples <- gsub("^X", "", samples)
  otus <- colnames(otu_mat_new)[colSums(otu_mat_new[samples, ]) > 0]
  cat(run, ":", length(otus), "OTUs\n")
}

# OTUs pro Lauf als Liste
otus_per_run <- list()
for (run in c("EC24_245", "3XX", "Popa", "Buse")) {
  samples <- meta_df_clean$sample[meta_df_clean$sequencing_run == run]
  samples <- gsub("^X", "", samples)
  otus_per_run[[run]] <- colnames(otu_mat_new)[colSums(otu_mat_new[samples, ]) > 0]
}

# Paarweiser Overlap
cat("Überlapp EC24 & 3XX:", length(intersect(otus_per_run$EC24_245, otus_per_run$`3XX`)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp EC24 & Buse:", length(intersect(otus_per_run$EC24_245, otus_per_run$Buse)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp 3XX & Buse:", length(intersect(otus_per_run$`3XX`, otus_per_run$Buse)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp alle 4:", length(Reduce(intersect, otus_per_run)), "\n")

cat("OTU-Tabelle:", nrow(otu_mat_new), "Samples ×", ncol(otu_mat_new), "OTUs\n")
```

Der geringe Overlap erklärt den Median von 0.98 -\> in Diskussion erwähnen!

# Unclassified Fungi rausfiltern, ist zum Großteil Käfer- oder Pflanzen DNA

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: Blastn_Genbank


# Unclassified 50 mit den häufigsten reads prüfen
# Reads pro unclassified ASV summieren
unclassified_asvs <- tax_df %>%
  filter(Phylum == "p__Fungi_phy_Incertae_sedis" | is.na(Phylum)) %>%
  pull(ASV)

unclassified_reads <- rowSums(otu_table(ps)[unclassified_asvs, ])

# Top 50 nach Reads
top50_unclassified <- sort(unclassified_reads, decreasing = TRUE)[1:50]
top50_ids <- asv_map$asv_id[asv_map$sequence %in% names(top50_unclassified)]

# Als FASTA exportieren
top50_seqs <- asv_map %>%
  filter(asv_id %in% top50_ids)

fasta_lines <- paste0(">", top50_seqs$asv_id, "\n", top50_seqs$sequence)

writeLines(
  fasta_lines,
  file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/unclassified_top50.fasta")
)

cat("FASTA exportiert:", nrow(top50_seqs), "Sequenzen\n")

# Blast zeigt, die meisten unklassifizierten "Pilze" sind Käfer oder Pflanzen-DNA, die fälschlicherweise als Kingdom=Fungi klassifiziert wurden in Unite --> Rausfiltern!
```

```{r}
# ── Chunk 1: Filter ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ps_filtered <- subset_taxa(ps,
  Phylum != "p__Fungi_phy_Incertae_sedis" & !is.na(Phylum))
cat("ASVs vorher:", ntaxa(ps), "\n")
cat("ASVs nachher:", ntaxa(ps_filtered), "\n")
cat("Entfernt:", ntaxa(ps) - ntaxa(ps_filtered), "\n")

# ── UC-Datei einlesen ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
uc <- read.table(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/OTU_v2/otus.uc"),
                 sep = "\t", header = FALSE,
                 col.names = c("type", "cluster", "size", "pct_id", "strand",
                               "q_start", "t_start", "alignment",
                               "query", "target"))

# ── ASV → OTU Mapping ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
asv_to_otu <- uc %>%
  filter(type %in% c("H", "S")) %>%
  mutate(
    asv_id = gsub(";size=.*", "", query),
    otu_id = ifelse(type == "S",
                    gsub(";size=.*", "", query),
                    gsub(";size=.*", "", target))
  ) %>%
  select(asv_id, otu_id)

# ── Gefilterte OTU-IDs über Taxonomie ────────────────────────────────────────
good_otu_ids <- asv_to_otu %>%
  left_join(asv_map, by = "asv_id") %>%
  filter(sequence %in% taxa_names(ps_filtered)) %>%
  pull(otu_id) %>%
  unique()

cat("Gefilterte OTU-IDs:", length(good_otu_ids), "\n")

otu_mat_f   <- otu_mat_new[, colnames(otu_mat_new) %in% good_otu_ids]
otu_mat_t_f <- t(otu_mat_f)
cat("Gefilterte OTU-Tabelle:", nrow(otu_mat_f), "Samples ×",
    ncol(otu_mat_f), "OTUs\n")

# ── Taxonomie für gefilterte OTUs ────────────────────────────────────────────
tax_df_f <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_filtered))
tax_df_f$ASV           <- rownames(tax_df_f)
tax_df_f$Genus_clean   <- gsub("g__", "", tax_df_f$Genus)
tax_df_f$Species_clean <- gsub("s__", "", tax_df_f$Species)

```
